assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one standalone fullbleed 16:9 cinematic background image for an opening film, WITHOUT ANY TEXT.
Input image: the supplied nine-panel storyboard is visual reference only. Closely match ONLY the photographic visual of the TOP LEFT panel (01, Earth opening), including its camera angle, brightness, realistic texture and luminous black/gold/amber atmosphere. Ignore and remove every heading, title, caption, panel border and all other panels.
Primary request: photorealistic Earth viewed from a low orbital angle, a recognizable curved planet surface with recognizable continent shapes, dark oceans and densely scattered tiny warm golden city lights linked by a few very fine ornamental golden network filaments as in the reference. These lights are decorative opening imagery, not operational data.
Composition: one wide horizontal 16:9 frame. The Earth arc spans the entire lower part of the frame, its bright atmospheric rim rises gently toward upper left/center and curves down to the right. Planet fills approximately bottom 65 percent. A bright restrained amber sunrise emerges from the far horizon near upper center-left, warm shafts barely visible. Dark almost black sky above leaves space for later code-rendered typography. Central Earth surface lower center is dark enough for later title overlay, with luminous gold accents around it.
Look: exactly the premium cinematic photographic mood of the top-left reference panel, rich black oceans, subtle cool natural atmosphere at horizon only, bright amber/gold city glow, crisp continent/city detail, strong depth. Not a dark generic macro surface. Earth should clearly read as Earth. Slightly luminous, detailed and compelling on a large presentation screen.
Constraints: single fullbleed image only, no collage, no panels, no border. ZERO text, ZERO letters, ZERO digits, no Korean, no captions, no heading, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no charts, no scale or coordinates. No spacecraft, no robots, no fantasy planet, no dramatic fantasy nebula, no floating technology panels. Match reference Earth imagery rather than overdesign.
